info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fraud Investigation Management API
info.description: The Fraud Investigation Management API enables financial institutions to efficiently manage fraud-related cases associated with customer cards. Users can utilize this endpoint to update the status, details, or findings of ongoing investigations based on the card ID and specific parameters. Typical consumers include fraud analysts and risk management teams who need to ensure timely and accurate handling of fraud cases. By streamlining the investigation process, this API helps enhance operational efficiency and improve customer trust in banking services.
